protocol_name: Candidate Muon-Lag Extension: pre-data test protocol
observable: A fitted muon decay lifetime in each gamma bin, obtained from a declared time-resolved decay sample.
required_preregistration: Decay acceptance, detector efficiency, backgrounds, and beam-loss model
Likelihood choice, nuisance parameters, and their constraints
Treatment of momentum spread and correlations

likelihood.summary_model: Independent Gaussian likelihood for preregistered fitted lifetime estimates.
likelihood.event_model: Ideal exponential lifetime likelihood only after background and acceptance correction.
likelihood.rejection_condition: Reject this candidate extension if the preregistered high-gamma analysis gives 2*(ln L_SR-ln L_FPM) >= 25 under the declared uncertainty model.

scope.physical_evidence_status: No high-gamma, likelihood-ready public decay-lifetime series is bundled with this protocol.
scope.interpretation: The protocol is a conditional test of the candidate motion-to-ledger and decay-hazard extension, not a test of Axioms A1-A5 alone.
